title: Gubernaut: A Deterministic Homeostatic Controller for Affect-Regulated LLM Agents, Validated Across Independent Model Families
description:
The paper and its complete validation record for the Gubernaut Cognitive Controller (GCC), a model-agnostic, deterministic runtime control layer for LLM agents built as a Nelson-Narens monitoring-control loop: the object level reads and writes text, while a token-free meta level reads only numeric telemetry {intensity, valence, repetition} and returns a regulating posture. Because the meta level ingests zero tokens, no injection channel to the controller exists by construction (an architectural property, not yet adversarially tested); the text-exposed arbiter's posture compliance is measured, not assumed.

Headline result (pre-registered, generate-once / judge-many, over a symmetric 4x4 generator-by-judge matrix of GPT-5.5, Claude Opus 4.8, Gemini 3.5 Flash, and Grok 4.3): the regulated arm is calmer in 15 of 16 cells by sign (11 of 12 off-diagonal) and 13 of 16 at p<.05. The one null cell (-0.04, GPT x Gemini) is reported alongside the headline, not hidden; the three sub-threshold cells all fall on the single near-saturated host. The effect survives a lineage-independent fourth judge family (xAI), which is strong evidence it is not an artifact of shared judge lineage or style. The clearest mechanism is the recovery signature: arousal integrates under sustained attack, then decays, valence-gated, once the adversary de-escalates, replicating in all four families.

This record contains the camera-ready paper (PDF) and the validation release: all endurance and evaluation transcripts for all four generators, both arms, verbatim; all judge panels (four judge families, three samples per unit) with SHA-256 provenance; the sealed matrices (the frozen three-model matrix and the 4x4); tidy per-turn telemetry and dampening tables (CSV); the extraction, statistics, and figure scripts that reproduce every published table and figure from the raw files; and all pre-registration documents with their lock timestamps.

Withheld, per the pre-registered contamination principle: the faculty prompts, the judge rubric text, the controller's calibration constants, and the held-out stressor texts.

No consciousness claims are made. The system is a regulation layer: measured, pre-registered, and falsifiable.
